notes.title: 🔴🔴🔴 Turtles at Steam Next Fest with Developer Live Broadcast
notes.content:
Hello Turtle Savers!

We're broadcasting Turtles! for the Next Fest event on Steam!

It's amazing to be part of this NextFest Event with our small game Turtles!
Fasten your seat belts and get ready for some good old gameplay on this action-puzzle game that will keep you entertained for some good time! Come and check it out, we're here to answer your questions and listen to your comments and we love you to watch the stream, so don't forget to join our discord.

Of course if you'd like to support us, it's best to wishlist the game, then join our discord for the hottest news about the game.

notes.title: Save them all during SteamFest 2022!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're delighted to announce the release of the demo of our game [b]Turtles![/b] during the [b]Steam NextFest [/b]2022!

It's still in a early version, but fully playable and we had a lot of fun trying it out and playing it lately.

There are a lot of levels for you to play and the gameplay is fully implemented.

We hope you will enjoy it too as much as we did!  Let us know what you think about on our discord ;)

notes.title: Turtles! Update 0.3.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Turtles! is moving on: build 0.3.2 is finally live!

We have been working hard to bring you new bug fixes, balance changes, some tutorial features, & updated designs.


[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]

[b]Level Design:[/b][list]
[*] Levels 1,2,3,4,5,6 are tweaked for better gameplay.
[/list]
[b]Additions:[/b][list] 
[*] Crab lines can now contain 15 slots
[*] Crab lines can now contain 15 empty slots
[*] Retry button available in the pause menu
[*] Game Statistics
[*] AST-Hero link in the main menu
[*] New main menu Icons designs
[*] New Pause/Score/Endgame Menu Icons Designs
[*] New Levels Navigation Menu Design
[*] New Navigation in the main menu, we can now access volume control and other icons on the right side
[*] Scoring system
[*] New victory screen
[*] Scoring bars design
[*] Stars now explodes in smaller ones when counting points
[*] Island menu has now 3 stars instead of 1
[*] Side bars fill up faster
[*] New bar markers
[*] New turtle movement on the map
[*] Exposition mode (developer mode only)
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b][list] 
[*] When leaving the level while packing/retrying, the destination created an unavailable slot. This slot is now available.
[*] On the game-over and retry panels, the crabs and seagulls were waiting before they could move when restarting the game. They now move immediately.
[/list]


[url=https://discord.gg/3zVD3PM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589923/ada134c0bc014fef50f4aec6f6143aff141b651a.png[/img][/url]
